# Prospective Breast BI Phosphoproteome

Dataset id: pdc-prospective-breast-bi-phosphoproteome

## Read this first: what these data CANNOT support

- No blocking limitation has been recorded. This is not the same as there being none: check the review status below.

## What it is

- Cohort: 127 cases
- Measurements: Phosphoproteome mass spectrometry (TMT10 / DDA)
- Access: open. Direct download from the PDC portal or its API; no account required

- Articles that analyzed these data: 2

- Reuse gap index: -1.04 (negative means less reused than comparable datasets)
